text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D2","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 12±0.1"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"IZBP"}],"comment":"Dimension D2 (page 1, \"⌀ 12±0.1\") has a tolerance band of 0.2 mm total (±0.1), which is 0.1 mm or less in each direction, on a part that is zinc plated (IZBP). The plating thickness will add to the finished diameter and may push it out of tolerance during assembly. The designer should either increase the tolerance band to allow for the plating build-up or specify that the dimension applies before plating.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating the dimension applies before plating, or widen the tolerance to account for the IZBP coating thickness."}]}
